guard: # One row per command, with the verdict the named guard answers today. Columns:
#   context    polecat, refinery, crew or other — the session the row is judged in
#   command    a Go-quoted string literal (so tabs and newlines in a command survive)
#   reason_key a stable substring of the refusal reason; empty for allow
#   bead       the bead that added the row; seed for the first rows
#   stamp      empty until the freeze-rule bead fills it; while it is empty a
#              row may end at the bead column and the missing field reads as ""
# {town} and {home} in a command are replaced with the fixture's town root and
# Seed rows come from the command strings of the three guards' existing tests.
# A row records the verdict the guard gives, not an opinion about it.
# A container_suite or test_scope refusal is recorded under the polecat context
# the hook consults the rule in: those classifiers are role-blind, but the hook
# only calls them for a polecat (tapGuardContainerSuite returns without a
# refusal for every other role), so a refusal recorded under another role would
# describe a session the rule never judges. Their allow rows also appear under
# the other contexts, where the hook lets the same command through.
